scripts.build: pnpm generate && pnpm typecheck && electron-vite build && node scripts/build-process-native.mjs
scripts.package:desktop: pnpm build && pnpm rebuild:electron && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs
scripts.test:unit: pnpm rebuild:node && node scripts/build-process-native.mjs && vitest run
scripts.test:portable: node scripts/check-test-environment.mjs && pnpm rebuild:node && vitest run --config vitest.portable.config.ts
scripts.test:files: node scripts/check-test-environment.mjs && pnpm rebuild:node && node scripts/build-process-native.mjs && vitest run --config vitest.files.config.ts
scripts.test:process: node scripts/check-test-environment.mjs && pnpm rebuild:node && node scripts/build-process-native.mjs && vitest run --config vitest.process.config.ts
scripts.test:native: pnpm rebuild:node && pnpm build && vitest run --config vitest.native.config.ts
scripts.test:electron: pnpm rebuild:electron && pnpm build && playwright test
scripts.test:electron:portable: pnpm rebuild:electron && pnpm build && playwright test platform-smoke.spec.ts
